About medac

We are a strong community: with more than 2,000 employees worldwide, we are committed to improving human health. Our work is more than just a job. With a career at medac, you can make a real difference in the industry. Look into this job opportunity and become part of an exceptional workforce.

At our location in Wedel near Hamburg, we are looking for a Medical Expert - Clinical Science (all genders).

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Medical Expert responsible for driving clinical, scientific, and regulatory activities across the product lifecycle, with a strong focus on the development of high-quality regulatory documentation, scientific data interpretation, and support for global submissions and lifecycle management. You will act as a cross-functional scientific partner, translating complex clinical data into clear scientific and regulatory strategies and ensuring consistency across development programs and marketed products. You will support regulatory interactions, benefit-risk assessments, and evidence-based decision-making in collaboration with clinical development, regulatory affairs, pharmacovigilance, and other key stakeholders. In this role, you will provide medical-scientific oversight of medac’s Managed Access Programs (MAP) and Named Patient Use (NPU) requests, ensuring patient-focused and scientifically robust benefit-risk evaluations.

Author, review, and lead high-quality clinical and regulatory documents (CTD), including clinical overviews and clinical summaries, clinical expert statements, Risk Management Plans (RMPs), SmPCs, CCDS, PILs, PSURs / DSURs, and other lifecycle management documents
Support global regulatory submissions, variations, renewals, and post-approval activities
Interpret and integrate clinical, safety, and scientific data into robust regulatory and medical-scientific positions
Contribute to regulatory strategy documents and briefing packages, and support interactions with health authorities, including scientific advice procedures and regulatory meetings
Ensure scientific consistency, quality, and compliance across submission and lifecycle documentation
Collaborate cross-functionally with clinical development, regulatory affairs, pharmacovigilance, and commercial functions
Support benefit-risk evaluations and medical-scientific assessments across the product portfolio
Evaluate Managed Access Program (MAP) and Named Patient Use (NPU) requests and provide evidence-based medical recommendations
Contribute to programs involving innovative therapies, including cell therapies and ATMPs

Advanced degree in medicine, pharmacy, pharmaceutical sciences, life sciences, biomedical sciences, immunology, or a related medical-scientific discipline
Several years of experience in clinical development, clinical science, medical affairs, regulatory affairs, or a comparable role within the pharmaceutical industry
Solid understanding of global drug development, regulatory requirements, and lifecycle management
Demonstrated experience in regulatory submission activities, including CTD authoring and Module 2 documentation
Experience in cell therapies, Managed Access Programs, and Named Patient Use
Strong scientific writing and communication skills
Strong analytical thinking and benefit-risk assessment capabilities
Ability to translate complex scientific information into clear and actionable recommendations
Fluency in English; some German preferred

Your work-life balance is important to us; we offer flexible working hours with the option of working a proportion of those hours remotely, 30 annual vacation days, and an excellent cafeteria
Attractive salaries and success-based bonuses for all medac employees
Individual training opportunities: Our medac academy offers a wide range of programmes including leadership training, coaching essentials, and language classes
A funded pension scheme and other social benefits
We care for our employees beyond the workplac...

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

The Clinical Diagnostics Division (CDD) provides innovative diagnostic solutions across selected in vitro diagnostics (IVD) market segments and has been a trusted partner to the IVD industry for more than 40 years.

Our portfolio includes solutions for drugs-of-abuse testing, therapeutic drug monitoring, quality control, sepsis diagnosis, prenatal screening and more. In addition, CDD offers advanced laboratory instrumentation and high-throughput automation solutions for a wide range of clinical laboratory environments.

Our products and solutions are delivered through direct sales, regional distributors and OEM partnerships.

Territory: Eastern & Central Germany
ZIP Codes: 01, 02, 04, 06, 07, 08, 09, 30, 31, 32, 34, 36, 37, 38, 99
Field-based / Remote within the territory

Discover Impactful Work

We are looking for an experienced Account Manager (m/f/d) – Clinical Diagnostics to drive commercial growth across Eastern and Central Germany.

In this field-based role, you will take ownership of a strategically important sales territory, developing existing customer relationships while identifying and winning new business opportunities.

As a trusted advisor to clinical laboratories and healthcare customers, you will combine your scientific understanding with a consultative sales approach to identify customer needs, understand laboratory workflows and develop solutions that deliver measurable value.

You will work closely with customers, key decision-makers and internal cross-functional teams to expand our market presence, increase revenue and strengthen long-term partnerships.

A Day in the Life

- Develop and execute strategic territory and account plans to achieve or exceed annual sales targets
- Take full ownership of revenue growth, pipeline development and commercial performance within the assigned territory
- Manage, develop and grow relationships with existing key accounts
- Identify, qualify and convert new business opportunities within clinical laboratories and other relevant customer segments
- Build strong relationships with laboratory managers, clinicians, procurement teams, technical specialists and other key decision-makers
- Apply a consultative selling approach to understand customer applications, workflows, challenges and future requirements
- Position Thermo Fisher Scientific’s clinical diagnostic solutions effectively and develop compelling value propositions
- Manage the complete sales cycle, from opportunity identification and customer engagement through negotiation and closing
- Collaborate closely with Applications, Technical Service, Marketing, Customer Service and other commercial teams to deliver an outstanding customer experience
- Maintain an accurate and high-quality sales pipeline, forecast and customer data within Salesforce
- Monitor market trends, competitor activities and customer developments to identify new growth opportunities
- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at customer meetings, industry events, conferences and exhibitions
- Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and develop sustainable, long-term business partnerships

Keys to Success

You combine a strong scientific or technical background with commercial drive and a genuine passion for understanding and solving customer challenges.

You are comfortable managing a large territory independently, identifying growth opportunities and engaging with stakeholders at different levels of an organization. At the same time, you enjoy working collaboratively within a global, cross-functional organization.

Education & Experience

- Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Biology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Medical Technology or another relevant scientific discipline
- Minimum 5 years of successful sales experience, preferably within clinical diagnostics, IVD, laboratory solutions, life sciences, medical technology or healthcare
- Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets and developing a sales territory
- Experience managing complex customer relationships and sales cycles
- Experience working with clinical laboratories, hospitals or other diagnostic customers is highly desirable

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

- Strong technical and scientific understanding, with the ability to quickly understand customer applications and laboratory workflows
- Excellent consultative selling, communication, presentation and negotiation skills
- Strong commercial mindset with the ability to identify and develop new business opportunities
- Demonstrated ability to build trusted, long-term relationships with customers and key decision-makers
- Strong analytical, strategic planning and territory management capabilities
- Results-oriented, proactive and accountable approach to sales
- Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a cross-functional and matrix organization
- Proficiency with CRM systems, preferably Salesforce, and Microsoft Office applications
- Valid driver’s license
- Willingness to travel approximately 50–75% within the assigned territory

Language Requirements

- Fluent German is essential (C1 level or above)
- Strong professional English skills are required for communication within our international organization

Benefits:
We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch (https://jobs.thermofisher.com/global/en/5-reasons-to-work-at-thermo-fisher-scientific)  as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific (https://corporate.thermofisher.com/us/en/index.html) , where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

jobs.occupation: Research Assistant/Doctoral Student (f/m/d) - Chair of Behavioral Accounting (Research-Manager/in)
jobs.employer_name: WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management-1
jobs.description:
General informationThe new Chair of Behavioral Accounting ( Prof. Dr. Victor van Pel t) at WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management in Vallendar is dedicated to the empirical and experimental analysis of decision-making behavior in accounting settings. The focus is on behavioral accounting, controlled, online, and field experiments, and contemporary trends like the use of artificial intelligence. Our research examines how controls, performance feedback, and reporting choices shape the judgments and decisions of managers, employees, investors, and other firm stakeholders. WHU has an international orientation, offers an excellent research environment, and has a vibrant doctoral programme. Moreover, our chair is part of the Finance and Accounting Group, which organizes frequent reading groups and research seminars that further strengthen your doctoral training. This position is particularly suited for people (f/m/d) interested in behavioral research, with a focus on accounting questions, and a career in academia.
Your mission Research
• Conducting independent research in the field of behavioral accounting, in particular on experimental issues in reporting, controls, performance feedback, and the use of artificial intelligence in accounting.
• The aim is to present research results at international conferences and publish them in leading journals.

Teaching
• Collaboration in the implementation and further development of courses in the field of financial and management accounting (e.g. preparation of materials, supervision of students, data analysis or support with experiments).
• Opportunity to gradually take on your own teaching responsibilities and further develop your teaching skills as part of your doctoral programme.

Doctoral programme
• Active participation in WHU’s structured doctoral programme, which includes methodological and theoretical courses, research seminars, and presentations in the doctoral colloquium.
• Use of the international research environment for professional and personal development, including access to laboratory and online recruitment resources and support for conference travel.

Your profileAcademic background
• Above-average master’s degree in accounting, economics, finance or a related area.
• Ideally, your master’s thesis was written in a subject area related to behavioral or experimental research.
• We particularly value if you’ve finished a preparation track, like a research master or another specialized graduate research program.

Technical and methodological skills
• Strong mathematical programming, analytical, and critical thinking skills.
• Experience with experimental design, statistical inference, and academic research and writing practices.
• Proficiency in at least one of the following statistical programming languages: R, Stata, or Python.
• Experience with oTree for conducting experiments is a big plus.

Research interests
• Strong interest in experimental behavioral research, particularly in the areas of accounting.
• Interest in topics such as misreporting, performance measurement and feedback, controls, incentives, and contemporary issues like sustainability and the use of AI is particularly welcome.

Personal requirements
• A passion for learning and scientific research in an international environment.
• Excellent written and spoken English proficiency (German proficiency is not required).

What we offer Academic Environment

WHU has more than 60 faculty members in the fields of management, finance and accounting, economics, entrepreneurship and innovation, marketing and sales, and supply chain management. Research at WHU aims to adhere to three principles: quality, internationality, and practical relevance.

WHU is an equal opportunity employer and thus welcomes applications from individuals with diverse backgrounds. We believe in the benefits of diversity and therefore foster an international, inclusive, and inspiring working environment.

ContactFor questions please contact:

Professor Victor van Pelt
email: Victor.vanPelt@whu.edu

About usAs one of Germany’s top private business schools, WHU is consistently ranked among Europe’s finest. Since its inception in 1984, we have driven excellence and entrepreneurial thinking, producing innovative research that steers progress for all areas of society and industry. At both the Vallendar and Düsseldorf campuses, we empower leaders to become responsible changemakers, guided by integrity, diversity, and strengthened by a deep sense of togetherness.

jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG.
jobs.description:
This is a new, dedicated Commercial Sales Manager (m/f/d) position created to provide specialized oversight for the Erfurt factory's generator business. The role addresses the need for focused commercial management due to an expanding product portfolio, including electric motors and maritime applications, and increasing complexity in external projects with international clients. To meet these business objectives, the role is structured around three core areas: comprehensive Commercial Offer and Bid Management for all projects, rigorous Sales Process and Financial Governance using tools like Salesforce and PATAC, and proactive Stakeholder and Risk Management to navigate complex international requirements and ensure seamless collaboration between technical and commercial teams. Given the focus on these areas, the ideal candidate will be a subject matter expert with extensive experience in commercial sales and contract management within an industrial manufacturing context. A proven ability to manage complex international projects, including financial calculations and risk mitigation, is essential for success in this role.

How You’ll Make an Impact

- Lead the development and preparation of commercial offers for all internal and external generator, electric motor, and maritime application projects originating from the Erfurt factory.
- Structure, draft, and negotiate complex sales contracts, amendments, and bid documents in collaboration with technical sales, legal, and business management teams.
- Manage the end-to-end bid and proposal process, ensuring all submissions are competitive, compliant, and aligned with strategic business objectives.
- Develop and implement pricing strategies and perform detailed cost calculations for all tenders and proposals.
- Manage all commercial sales activities and pipeline information within Salesforce, ensuring data accuracy and generating regular sales reports.
- Execute and oversee core commercial processes, including the Project Approval and Tender Approval Committee (PATAC) workflow, bond applications, and financial clearances.
- Ensure the fulfillment of contractual financial obligations, coordinating with finance on topics such as invoicing and payment terms.
- Continuously improve commercial sales processes to enhance efficiency and mitigate risks.
- Serve as the primary commercial liaison for key external clients, managing complex requirements related to international tax issues, permanent establishment (PE) setup, and local installation services.
- Collaborate closely with the technical sales team to ensure proposed solutions are commercially viable and to prevent execution problems on complex projects.
- Identify, assess, and mitigate commercial, financial, and contractual risks throughout the entire sales cycle.
- Coach and delegate work to lower-level professionals, acting as a subject matter expert for commercial sales processes.

What You Bring

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.
- Several years of experience in a senior commercial sales, contract management, or bid management role, preferably within the power generation or heavy industrial equipment sector.
- Demonstrated experience managing large, complex international projects and navigating associated tax, legal, and logistical challenges.
- Proficiency with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and financial calculation tools is required.
- German and English fluency.

Rewards/Benefits

- In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
- We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
- We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
- The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
- In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

Roles and Responsibilities:

- Installation, commissioning and sustaining of Kokusai semiconductor manufacturing equipment at customer sites in Dresden and worldwide.
- Maintain a safe working environment and strictly adhere to all safety guidelines, policies and procedures at customer sides.
- Report on schedule performance and take action to resolve any delays, or issues.
- Troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair any issues that occur.
- Being a major part in building and help growing our new team in Dresden.

Skills and Experience that we are looking for:

- Bachelors / master’s degree / Level 6 or equivalent qualification in Mechanical, Electronical or Mechatronic Engineering or Certified Technician.
- Comfortable working on complex electro-mechanical equipment in a cleanroom manufacturing environment, good manual dexterity with a high focus on safety and quality.
- Aptitude to work with electro-mechanical schematics and ladder logic.
- Good communication skills with the ability to work independently as well as the team environment.
- Minimum 2-3 -years equipment maintenance and/or installation experience of semiconductor/pharma/medical or scientific equipment.
- Previous experience of installing or maintaining vertical diffusion furnaces or other semiconductor equipment would be a distinct advantage.
- Working knowledge of MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint).
- Fluent in English and German language and a valid work permit for an EU country is essential.
- Willing to travel to other EU customers and support our affiliate companies in US and Asia.

Aufgaben

- Collaboration & Requirements: Partner with stakeholders to identify automation opportunities, translate business needs into technical solutions, and document workflows and architectures.
- Cloud Engineering & Automation: Architect and maintain automated workflows and integrations using AWS services (Lambda, Step Functions, S3, DynamoDB, API Gateway, EventBridge) and platforms like n8n or Make.com. Enable seamless data flow between cloud infrastructure and external platforms such as Zendesk, Salesforce, and Baserow. Ensure reliability through monitoring, error-handling, and alerting.
- AI-Powered Solutions: Leverage Amazon Bedrock, Large Language Models, and Amazon Q to build AI agents, RAG pipelines, and intelligent workflows for document extraction, content generation, and conversational AI.

Profil

- Communication & Languages: Strong collaboration skills; able to present technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders. Fluent in English; German is a plus.
- Experience: 3 + years in software engineering, cloud development, or AI/ML automation. Degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
- Programming & Cloud Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript. Hands-on experience with AWS services (Lambda, Step Functions, Bedrock, Connect, S3, DynamoDB). Understanding of RESTful APIs, webhooks, and event-driven architectures.
- AI/ML & LLM Expertise: Experience with Amazon Bedrock and Amazon Q. Skilled in prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and building AI agents for production use cases.
- Data Handling: Familiarity with relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (DynamoDB), plus experience with data pipelines and tools like Baserow or Airtable.

Bonus skills (Nice to have)

- Certifications & Infrastructure: AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, Developer, or ML specialty). Experience with Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.
- Advanced AI & Other: Experience with SageMaker, vector databases, or custom ML pipelines. Background in sustainability tech or enterprise automation tools (Power Automate) is a plus.

Angebot

- Future-proof career: Join one of Europe's leading environmental service providers and help shape digital transformation in a growing sustainability-focused industry.
- Flexibility that works for you: Benefit from flexible working arrangements, remote work options and a healthy work-life balance.
- Modern technology stack: Work with AWS, Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q and leading AI technologies to develop innovative automation solutions.
- Room to innovate: Bring your ideas to life in an environment that encourages ownership, creativity and continuous improvement.
- Benefits beyond the salary: Enjoy attractive additional benefits including company pension contributions, Deutschlandticket subsidy or Edenred card, bike leasing, corporate benefits and comprehensive health programmes.
- Technology with purpose: Build solutions that support sustainability and help advance our mission of a waste-free future.

Deloitte offers leading audit and consulting services in Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Consulting, and Advisory – for nearly 90% of the Fortune Global 500® and numerous private companies. We deliver innovative thinking, solve complex challenges, and promote sustainable growth. With around 470,000 employees worldwide, we offer outstanding career opportunities – driven by a strong sense of “we” and a diversity of perspectives and skills.
The AI Experience Center (“AIXC”) is a highly innovative venue located in Düsseldorf, aimed at providing tangible interactive experiences to Deloitte's clients and practitioners by demonstrating AI’s potential for business and showcasing Deloitte’s own AI solutions & capabilities. The state-of-the-art space is equipped with cutting-edge AI software and hardware and is the latest addition to Deloitte’s portfolio of experience spaces in Düsseldorf (complementing the existing spaces of Deloitte Greenhouse & the Smart Factory) Secure our shared success and make a difference with us as: Head of AI Experience Center (m/f/d).

Standort: Düsseldorf.

Your impact:

As Head of the AI Experience Center (m/f/d), you serve as its ambassador and lead its strategy, operations, and market positioning. You drive client engagement, oversee daily management, and ensure the Center’s long-term growth and commercial success.

- Ownership & Leadership: You are the face of the space and take full end-to-end responsibility for the AIXC, ensuring its success as a leading AI innovation and experience hub
- Vision & Positioning: You shape the strategic direction, oversee the design and delivery of workshops and lab offerings (in collaboration with Deloitte Greenhouse), and narrative of the AI Experience Center
- AI Content & Assets Pipeline: You stay at the forefront of external AI market developments and continuously connect with AI innovators & specialists to onboard new AI assets to the space and design new formats & journeys
- Brand & Communication: You represent the AI Experience Center internally & externally, through targeted communication, events, and marketing initiatives. Furthermore, build & maintain a networks & key relationships that will enable success
- Business Enablement & Market Impact: You drive the adoption and utilization of the Center across client engagements, helping Deloitte teams showcase AI capabilities, create client value, and unlock new business opportunities

Your skillset:

- experienced leader (min. 8+ years of professional and leadership experience with a successful track record in business development & commercial ownership, ideally across industries & functions, or in a consulting environment
- excellent communication & stakeholder management skills and feel confident working with our diverse participant groups (from colleagues to startup founders to DAX board members)
- strong business and/or technical understanding of AI, emerging technologies, and/or digital transformation, and are able to connect client- and industry-specific challenges with AI technologies
- hands-on mentality with a structured mindset and want to work in and build a great team and contribute your skills
- excellent German and English skills, additional languages are a plus

Your chance:

- Best-in-class ongoing education at Deloitte University and through individual qualification programs and training sessions
- Extensive professional development opportunities with structured career planning, inclusive leadership, secondment programs, project-based job rotation, and support for societal engagement and corporate volunteering
- Work-family balance with a family advice service, mobile working, part-time hours, sabbaticals, support for family caregivers, counseling for parental leave, and much more
- A focus on health and fitness with regular health-themed days, partnerships with fitness providers, and support for sporting and team events
- Attractive employer benefits including bicycle and car leasing, a company smartphone for private use, and flexible working models (such as trust-based working hours and EU remote working)
- Plenty of scope for creativity and active promotion of an inclusive corporate culture – for instance through our diversity and inclusion employee networks

Are you ready? Make a difference with us!

Our recruiting team looks forward to receiving your application documents (CV as well as general qualification for university entrance, university and work references) via our online form. A cover letter and an application photo are not required.

Your contact for career-related questions

Our Talent Acquisition team – Aleksandra, Anja, Julia, Lea, Lisa, Silja, and their teams – are happy to support you with any questions regarding your career at Deloitte. You can reach us via email at career@deloitte.de or by phone at +49 211 87724111.
